title: Regular City Council Meeting 11/04/25
caveat: Findings from an automated review of an auto-captioned recording. Verify specifics against the video before repeating them.

findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council heard extensive public comment regarding a proposed commercial solar energy facility near North 33rd Street and Evergreen Court before unanimously voting down the special ordinance and rezoning request. The council also approved annual municipal insurance renewals, an employee health plan agreement, a residential setback variance on DeWitt Avenue, and a downtown facade rehabilitation grant.
